item.yharnam_casino.table_help: Place a deck at the dealer’s edge. Players join by placing chips at a seat.
item.yharnam_casino.wheel_help: Right-click to start the power meter. Click again to spin.
item.yharnam_casino.prize_ticket.tooltip: Present this ticket to the casino host for a roleplay prize.
item.yharnam_casino.chip_iou.use: Show this receipt to the cabinet owner in roleplay.
item.yharnam_casino.cabinet_key.tooltip: Right-click to open the cashbox. Sneak-right-click to set wager denominations.
item.yharnam_casino.gm_key.tooltip: Right-click to open any cashbox. Sneak-right-click to set wager denominations. Never assigns ownership.
message.yharnam_casino.denominations_req: Keep at least one denomination enabled.
message.yharnam_casino.vault_denied: You don't have access to this cabinet's safe.
message.yharnam_casino.dismantle_denied: The player who placed this cabinet can dismantle it.
message.yharnam_casino.key_nearby: Right-click your cabinet to link the key and stay near it.
message.yharnam_casino.vault_founder_onl: The player who placed the cabinet manages shared access.
message.yharnam_casino.vault_founder_pro: The player who placed the cabinet already has access.

message.yharnam_casino.vault_no_profit: This cabinet has no proceeds available.
message.yharnam_casino.gm_key_denied: Only GMs and administrators may use this key.
message.yharnam_casino.gm_key_inventory_: Free an inventory slot before requesting a GM key.

message.yharnam_casino.pool_full_refunde: The cash pool filled up, so your wager was returned.
message.yharnam_casino.use_chip: Right-click with a chip. See /yharnamcasino rules for the paytable.

message.yharnam_casino.jackpot: Jackpot! Payout %s and a prize ticket.

message.yharnam_casino.rules: A pair of any of the first three symbols pays ×2. Other pairs pay ×1. Triples pay as listed. Three of the first symbol also award a roleplay ticket. The theoretical chip return is 95.31%.
